user_request: ok, il faudra donc gerer aussi le cas ou plusieurs gardiens qui taunt en meme temps, l’effet que ca produit sur les monstres.
accepted_requirement: Handle simultaneous Guardian provocations and their result on each monster; keep previously accepted no-continuous-target-swapping direction.

proposal.one_status_per_monster: One provocation status with one source Guardian and one remaining duration; no strength, duration or icon stacking.
proposal.already_provoked: Keep the existing still-valid source Guardian and remaining duration. Incoming taunts neither replace it nor refresh it.
proposal.simultaneous_new_provocations: Collect eligible Guardian candidates in the same familiar phase before resolving ownership per monster; do not let actor iteration or drawing order choose the winner.
proposal.selection: Nearest valid Guardian among sources whose effect reaches the monster, respecting obstacles and actual attack/pursuit eligibility.
proposal.ties: Stable persistent actor identity breaks a remaining distance tie, with no random draw or per-frame reassignment.
proposal.different_monsters: Resolve each monster separately; several Guardians may win different targets in the same phase.
proposal.source_destroyed_or_recalled: Remove its provocation; the monster resumes its normal target selection. Another Guardian must actually provoke it to impose a new taunt; no automatic transfer of the old status.
proposal.visual: One provocation marker per affected monster, no repeated icon stack or target flip from simultaneous pulses.

remaining_details: Exact distance comparison for melee/ranged/immobile actors
Action/cooldown outcome for a Guardian whose simultaneous attempt wins no target
Sight loss, path becoming invalid and expiration timing
numerical_scope: No capacity, radius, duration or cooldown numbers changed or newly accepted by this follow-up.
